title: 稳压电源 12 V 点亮两颗白光 LED
summary: 把稳压电源调到 12 V、限流 50 mA，串联点亮两颗白光 LED；再想想电阻短路时限流怎么救场。
description: 稳压电源 12 V（限流 50 mA 作保护）：+12 V → 330 Ω → 白光 LED1 → 白光 LED2 → GND。两颗白光 LED 共约 6 V，电阻上约 6 V，电流远低于限流值，所以电源保持 CV。

cards.title: 12 V 和两颗白灯
text: 这一题没有步骤，**照目标电路图自己搭**。先选「直流稳压电源」，在「属性」里设 **12 V**、限流 **0.05 A**。

cards.title: 为什么限流设 50 mA
text: - 两颗白光 LED 各约 3 V，共 6 V；电阻上 $12 - 6 = 6$ V，$I \approx \frac{6}{330} \approx 18$ mA（算上两颗 LED 的小电阻，再稍小一点）。远低于 50 mA，电源一直是 **CV**。
- 万一电阻被短路（比如两只脚插进了同一列）：只剩两颗 LED，电流会冲到几百毫安，两颗都烧。
- 有了 50 mA 限流：电源进入 **CC**，把电流卡在 50 mA，电压自己降下来。50 mA 对 LED 仍然偏大，但不会立刻烧掉——这就是限流保护。

cards.title: 搭好，看电源屏幕
text: - 红色鳄鱼夹（+）接红轨，黑色（COM）接蓝轨。
- 两颗 LED 串联：LED1 的短脚和 LED2 的长脚在同一列。

cards.title: 带走
text: - 稳压电源 + 合理的限流 = 调试时的安全网。
- 12 V 串两颗白光 LED 留了 6 V 给电阻：余量足，电流稳。想串三颗，余量就只剩约 3 V 了。

en.title: Bench supply at 12 V, two white LEDs
en.summary: Set the bench supply to 12 V with a 50 mA limit and light two white LEDs in series; then think about how the limit saves you if the resistor gets shorted.
en.description: Bench supply at 12 V (50 mA limit as protection): +12 V → 330 Ω → white LED1 → white LED2 → GND. The two white LEDs drop about 6 V together and the resistor about 6 V; the current stays far below the limit, so the supply stays in CV.
hints: Click the bench supply and set 12 V and a 0.05 A limit.
Red alligator clip (+) to the red rail, black (COM) to the blue rail.
Two LEDs in series: LED1's short lead and LED2's long lead in the same column.
tests: Two white LEDs on, supply holds 12 V (CV mode)

cards.title: 12 V and two white LEDs
text: No steps here — **build it from the target schematic**. Pick Bench power supply and set **12 V** and a **0.05 A** limit in Properties.

cards.title: Why a 50 mA limit
text: - Two white LEDs at about 3 V each make 6 V; the resistor gets $12 - 6 = 6$ V, $I \approx \frac{6}{330} \approx 18$ mA (a bit less with the LEDs' small resistances). Far below 50 mA, so the supply stays in **CV**.
- If the resistor were shorted (say both legs in the same column), only the two LEDs would be left and the current would jump to hundreds of milliamps — both LEDs gone.
- With a 50 mA limit the supply goes into **CC**, holds the current at 50 mA and lets its voltage drop. 50 mA is still a lot for an LED, but not instant death — that is current-limit protection.

cards.title: Build it, watch the display
text: - Red alligator clip (+) to the red rail, black (COM) to the blue rail.
- The two LEDs in series: LED1's short lead and LED2's long lead share a column.

cards.title: Take away
text: - A bench supply with a sensible current limit is a safety net while debugging.
- Two white LEDs on 12 V leave 6 V for the resistor: plenty of headroom, a steady current. Three in series would leave only about 3 V.

measurements.ask: The current on the supply's display
If R1 were shorted, what would the supply with a 50 mA limit do?
choices: Go into CC, hold the current at 50 mA and let its voltage drop
Stay at 12 V while the current jumps to hundreds of mA
measurements.explain: The load wants more than the limit, so the supply holds the current: 50 mA, with the voltage down to what two LEDs drop at 50 mA — a little over 7 V.

tests.name: 两颗白光 LED 亮，电源保持 12 V（CV 模式）

measurements.ask: 电源屏幕上显示的电流
如果 R1 被短路，限流 50 mA 的电源会怎样？
choices: 进入 CC，把电流卡在 50 mA，输出电压降下来
保持 12 V，电流冲到几百毫安
measurements.explain: 负载想要的电流超过限流值，电源就进入恒流：电流 = 50 mA，电压降到两颗 LED 在 50 mA 时的压降，大约 7 V 多。

hints: 选中稳压电源，把电压设为 12 V，限流设为 0.05 A。
红色鳄鱼夹（+）接红轨，黑色（COM）接蓝轨。
两颗 LED 串联：LED1 的短脚和 LED2 的长脚在同一列。
